end_place: Tosor · South Shore of Issyk-Kul · Kyrgyzstan
about_p: An intimate yurt resort on the south shore of Lake Issyk-Kul. Mountains on one side, the lake on the other — so it is especially quiet, secluded and free here. For its first ten years, guests came by personal invitation only.
stay: a few steps from the water
stay_note: Families with children, extra beds and other formats — arranged individually.
banya_h: Banya on the shore of Issyk-Kul
banya_p: An ethno-banya inside a real yurt, 5–10 metres from the water. A hot steam room, a lounge with stained-glass windows facing the lake — and straight from the steam into Issyk-Kul.
banya_notes: Extensions, treatments and ceremonies are arranged separately.
Guests not staying at Ak-Tengir: towels and robe — 400 som per person.
Small groups can sometimes join other guests and share the cost.
groups_p: Come with your own programme or create it with us. Retreat organisers, tour operators, corporate and large groups get individual terms.
rest_p: Spend an active day — or simply stay on site with a book, tea and a view of the mountains.
near_h: Explore the south shore of Issyk-Kul
near_note: Travel times are approximate. We can help find a taxi or a ride, arrange a group transfer and pick a tour. For large groups we will plan a custom route.
end_note: Tour operators, organisers and groups — contact us directly to discuss individual terms.
price_note: Current prices and special terms are discussed personally.
